title: Painter in Abandoned Theater
description: A stern woman in a long black coat and gloves stands in a dilapidated theater, holding a painter's palette. Behind her is a large unfinished painting of a man in a dark coat walking on a path, surrounded by scattered paint supplies, palettes, and a worn red velvet chair on a glossy black tiled floor.
prompt: A stern middle-aged woman with dark hair in a bun, wearing a long black coat and gloves, stands holding a wooden painter's palette in an old decaying theater with cracked fresco ceiling. Behind her is a giant unfinished painting on canvas depicting a mysterious man in a dark coat and hat walking along a country path. Scattered paint palettes, brushes and cups lie across the glossy black tiled floor next to a worn red velvet armchair. Dramatic light rays shine from above, cinematic composition, moody atmosphere.
